top_stories.title: OpenAI's big Codex update is a direct shot at Claude Code [Paywalled]
top_stories.summary: OpenAI has released a significant update to its Codex coding tool, positioning it as a direct competitor to Anthropic's Claude Code. The update brings new capabilities to the macOS app and signals an intensifying battle in the AI coding tools space.

top_stories.title: Musk v. Altman Is a Battle for OpenAI's Soul
top_stories.summary: Wired reports on the ongoing legal confrontation between Elon Musk and Sam Altman, framing it as a fundamental dispute over the direction and control of OpenAI. The case touches on questions about OpenAI's transition from nonprofit to for-profit and what its founding mission means in practice.

top_stories.title: Google's AI Mode Update Tries to Kill Tab Hopping in Chrome
top_stories.summary: Google has updated its AI Mode to allow users to open and browse source links without leaving the current page, aiming to reduce friction in AI-assisted search. The feature is designed to keep users within the AI Mode interface while still providing access to underlying sources.

top_stories.title: The UK Launches Its $675 Million Sovereign AI Fund
top_stories.summary: The UK government has announced a £500 million ($675 million) sovereign AI fund aimed at building domestic AI infrastructure and capabilities. The investment reflects growing government interest in ensuring national competitiveness in the AI sector.

top_stories.title: The beginning of scarcity in AI
top_stories.summary: Venture capitalist Tom Tunguz argues that AI compute is entering a period of genuine scarcity, with demand for inference and training capacity outpacing supply. He outlines the implications for AI companies and startups navigating a tightening resource environment.

further_links.title: The 'AI is inevitable' trap [Paywalled]
further_links.summary: The Vergecast examines the framing of AI as an unstoppable force and how that narrative shapes public debate and policy around the technology.

further_links.title: Forbes 2026 AI 50 List | Top Artificial Intelligence Companies
further_links.summary: Forbes has released its annual AI 50 list highlighting the most promising private artificial intelligence companies of 2026.

further_links.title: Microsoft Expands Copilot and AI Agent Capabilities in Power Apps
further_links.summary: Microsoft has announced expanded Copilot and AI agent features within its Power Apps platform, deepening AI integration across its business productivity tools.

further_links.title: xAI rolls out Grok 4.3 beta for SuperGrok Heavy subscribers
further_links.summary: xAI has released a beta version of Grok 4.3 to its SuperGrok Heavy subscriber tier, continuing iterative updates to its large language model.

further_links.title: CIOs Struggle to Deliver Business Value as AI and Complexity Expose Gaps in Their Applications Strategy
further_links.summary: A new Info-Tech Research Group report finds that CIOs are increasingly challenged to demonstrate tangible business value from AI investments as application complexity grows.

further_links.title: The Download: bad news for inner Neanderthals, and AI warfare's human illusion
further_links.summary: MIT Technology Review examines the growing debate around meaningful human oversight in AI-enabled warfare, questioning whether 'human in the loop' safeguards are as substantive as claimed.

further_links.title: How robots learn: A brief, contemporary history
further_links.summary: MIT Technology Review surveys recent advances in robotic learning, tracing how techniques from reinforcement learning to foundation models have transformed what robots can do.

further_links.title: George Orwell Predicted the Rise of "AI Slop" in Nineteen Eighty-Four
further_links.summary: Open Culture draws a parallel between Orwell's concept of mechanically produced, low-quality content in Nineteen Eighty-Four and today's proliferation of AI-generated filler content online.
